name: Versus
description: Two versions of the same thing compared: what people think vs what the record shows, what a company says vs what its filing shows, shop A vs shop B. Panel a (a muted card) lands with its title and its lines one by one, then panel b (a bright card) with a VS badge between them; one side can be crossed out (strike) and the other can lift with an accent edge (pick). Use it when the beat is a contrast or a correction. Wants a box about 800 x 900 (stack) or 1200 x 600 (columns, which also suits a landscape frame). Three long points a side need about 800 x 1000 in a stack; content that does not fit tightens its spacing, then scales down as a whole, so a 600 x 500 box holds only short one-line points at full size.

a.description: first side, shown as the muted card: the claim, the common belief, shop A

title.description: who or what this side is, e.g. What they said

tag.description: optional small chip next to the title (under it when long or in columns), e.g. Press release / Oct

lines.description: 1-3 short points, landing one by one

text.description: one point; long ones wrap between words

at.description: Time this line lands: "line:4" or seconds from the clip start. Default: shortly after the previous one

b.description: second side, shown as the bright card: the fact, what the books say, shop B

title.description: who or what this side is, e.g. What the filing shows

tag.description: optional small chip next to the title (under it when long or in columns)

lines.description: 1-3 short points, landing one by one

text.description: one point; long ones wrap between words

at.description: Time this line lands: "line:4" or seconds from the clip start. Default: shortly after the previous one

layout.description: stack: a on top, b below, the biggest text; columns: side by side, for short lines in a wide box

strike.description: the side that gets crossed out and dims (the wrong one)

strike_at.description: Time the strike is drawn. Default: 0.8 s after the last line

pick.description: the side that lifts and gets the accent edge (the right one)

pick_at.description: Time the pick happens. Default: 0.8 s after the last line

a_at.description: Time panel a lands. Nothing shows before it. Default: the clip start

b_at.description: Time panel b and the VS badge land. Default: 0.6 s after a's last line

color.description: strike and pick colour: theme token or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on: light cards with ink text, or dark cards with snow text
